name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Tunes the adaptive WAN bitrate cap added in 0.0.32-0.0.34, per feedback that streaming still wasn't fast/high-bitrate enough: (1) the minimum bitrate the auto-cap will ever request is raised from 4 to 10 Mbps - a connection measuring below that still gets 10 Mbps requested rather than something proportionally lower. (2) The safety margin applied to measured bandwidth is raised from 75% to 85% of what a connection actually measures, so less real, usable bandwidth is left unused. (3) The bandwidth measurement itself now samples 5MB instead of 2MB, reducing how much TCP slow-start (the connection ramping up over its first several round-trips) skews a short sample toward reading lower than the connection's real sustained throughput - most noticeable on faster links. No forced item recreation; existing watch progress and ids are untouched.
